title: Riva Unveils First 112 Dolcevita Super with New Design
description: Riva's newly redesigned 112 Dolcevita Super debuts with innovative outdoor spaces and refined interiors, set to premiere at Cannes Yachting Festival.
html:
Riva Unveils 112 Dolcevita Super with Bold Redesign

Riva, a renowned brand under the Ferretti Group, has introduced the first model of its newly redesigned Riva 112 Dolcevita Super in La Spezia, Italy. This 34.4-meter yacht is set to make its premiere at the upcoming Cannes Yachting Festival. The design, crafted by the Italian studio Officina Italiana Design, features a sporty and assertive profile that aligns with Riva’s signature flybridge yachts. The yacht’s design emphasizes open-air spaces, providing an enhanced connection to the ocean environment.

The Riva 112 Dolcevita Super represents a significant evolution from its predecessors, with a focus on both aesthetic and functional enhancements. Notably, the flybridge furnishings have been completely overhauled to offer a more inviting and adaptable living space. The central area now includes a cocktail bar with stools and a television, complemented by a spacious sofa lounge. This redesign aims to provide a versatile setting that can cater to various social and relaxation needs.

Innovative Al Fresco Spaces Define New Riva Model

The Riva 112 Dolcevita Super places a strong emphasis on outdoor living, with its standout feature being the expansive beach club. This area includes a 35-square-meter platform that provides seamless access to the water. It also features an extra-large sofa with ventilated storage for two SeaBobs, and a garage under the sunpad that can accommodate a tender and a Jet Ski. The cockpit area further enhances the outdoor experience with two large sofas, freestanding furniture, and the option to install a Jacuzzi in the bow.

These al fresco spaces are designed to maximize enjoyment of the marine environment, providing ample opportunities for relaxation and recreation. The thoughtful layout and inclusion of versatile furniture ensure that guests can enjoy both social gatherings and quiet moments. The yacht’s exterior design reflects a commitment to creating a harmonious balance between style and functionality, ensuring that every detail serves a purpose.

Interior and Acoustic Comfort Take Center Stage

Inside the Riva 112 Dolcevita Super, the main saloon is available in two configurations, offering flexibility in layout to suit different preferences. The first configuration, selected for the initial hull, places the dining area at the aft and the lounge midships. Alternatively, a more traditional layout mirrors that of the Riva 102 Corsaro Super, with the lounge area at the entry and the dining area centrally located. High-gloss rosewood and black leather elements dominate the interior, creating a sophisticated and cohesive design.

Acoustic comfort has been a priority in the design of this model. The yacht features a reinforced lower deck bulkhead to separate the crew area from the four VIP cabins, enhancing privacy and reducing noise. Additionally, the flooring has been redesigned to minimize vibrations and slamming, ensuring a more comfortable experience for guests. These improvements reflect Riva’s dedication to providing a serene and enjoyable onboard environment.

The Riva 112 Dolcevita Super showcases a bold redesign that integrates innovative outdoor spaces with refined interior comfort. With its advanced features and thoughtful design, this model reaffirms Riva’s position as a leader in yacht design and construction. As Riva continues to expand its fleet, including the development of a 70-meter hybrid superyacht, the brand remains committed to delivering exceptional quality and performance.
